course_name_original: Retos de las empresas del siglo XXI

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and understanding: Be aware of the multidisciplinary context of engineering.

Engineering analysis: The ability to identify, formulate and solve engineering problems in their specialty; appropriately choose and apply established analytical, calculation and experimental methods; recognize the importance of social, health and safety, environmental, economic and industrial constraints.
Practical application of engineering: Knowledge of the social, health and safety, environmental, economic and industrial implications of engineering practice.
Practical application of engineering: General ideas on economic, organizational and management issues (such as project management, risk and change management) in the industrial and business context.
Judgment formulation: Ability to collect and interpret data and handle complex concepts within their specialty, to make judgments that involve reflection on ethical and social issues.
Applies methods, techniques, regulations, etc., typical of the engineering profession in known contexts.
Coordinates their work with other team members, contributes to the team's development of tasks and the creation of a good working environment.

syllabus_topics: Evolution of companies in the 20th century
Introduction What do companies demand from us? What do they offer us?
Centrality of people in the company.
Economic self-formation, labor sovereignty and Social Economy
teaching_methods: Problem-solving and project-based learning in real and/or simulated contexts

assessment_methods.method: Individual written and oral tests for the evaluation of technical competencies of the subject
Observation of student participation and attitude in the proposed training activities
Individual written, coding/programming and oral tests for the evaluation of technical competencies of the subject

assessment_rules: There are no recovery mechanisms for assessment activities.
